articles.title: Goa players take salary cut, Mumbai City refuse
articles.summary: Former US President Trump reportedly shocked NATO allies with a tariff warning, possibly linked to the acquisition of Greenland. Simultaneously, speculation arose about a potential pullout of ICE from Minnesota following significant backlash, leading to panic within the White House. These reports highlight distinct controversies involving international alliances and domestic immigration enforcement under the former administration.

articles.title: Building Bharat: India’s Startup Ecosystem as a Foundation of Nation Building
articles.summary: India's startup revolution transcends mere economics, acting as a crucial nation-building instrument. It's fundamentally reshaping how the country fosters capability, creates opportunities, and instills confidence for future generations. This vibrant ecosystem is vital for national progress and self-reliance, empowering innovation and driving India's developmental agenda, crucial for an aspirant to understand India's growth trajectory.

articles.title: Aerospace Materials Market Projected to Reach US$ 91.26 Billion by 2035, Supported by Increased Defense Procurement Activity Says Astute Analytica
articles.summary: The global aerospace materials market is projected for significant growth, nearly doubling from USD 44.28 billion in 2025 to USD 91.26 billion by 2035. This expansion highlights increasing demand for advanced materials crucial for modern aviation, including commercial and defence applications. For SSB aspirants, this trend underscores technology's role in national defence and economic development within the aerospace sector.

articles.title: Yale Achieves Academic Nirvana: Study Cannot Find A Single Republican Donor on the Faculty
articles.summary: A study, highlighted by Jonathan Turley, found no identifiable Republican donors among Yale University's faculty. This suggests a significant lack of political diversity in financial contributions among staff. The finding raises questions about ideological balance and representation in higher education, prompting discussion on political leanings and their broader societal impact.

articles.title: Unmanned Underwater Vehicles Market Projected to Reach US$ 46.62 Billion by 2035, Supported by Defense Procurement Programs Says Astute Analytica
articles.summary: The global market for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) is poised for massive expansion, projected to grow from US$ 5.49 billion in 2025 to an impressive US$ 46.62 billion by 2035, driven by a 23% Compound Annual Growth Rate. This substantial growth underscores the increasing importance of UUV technology in areas like underwater exploration, surveillance, and defence applications, offering significant future prospects for tech-savvy individuals.

articles.title: Surprise Suitor Emerges As Top Name For Elite Colorado OT Jordan Seaton In Transfer Portal
articles.summary: Former Colorado offensive tackle Jordan Seaton recently announced his intent to enter the college football transfer portal, surprising many in the sport. This move allows a student-athlete to switch universities and continue playing, reflecting the significant player mobility in American collegiate athletics. Such decisions highlight the strategic importance of talent acquisition for university sports programs nationwide.

articles.title: Bhairav Battalion to make R-Day Parade debut, Army assets to be showcased in battle array formation
articles.summary: The newly raised Bhairav light commando battalion is set to debut at the Republic Day Parade on January 26, highlighting India's evolving special forces. The parade will also showcase key Army assets and indigenous defence platforms, underscoring the nation's increasing self-reliance and modern military strength. This significant display reaffirms India's commitment to enhancing its national security and technological prowess.
